properties.description: Claims flat file -> stg.Plexis_Claim -> dbo.Claim_Header + dbo.Claim_Line. Self-contained and re-runnable for one Batch_Id.

userProperties.name: why
userProperties.value: contentMD5 fingerprints the file so the same export arriving twice under a new name is detectable. columnCount catches a schema change before a single row is copied.

message.value: @concat('Claims file contract violation. exists=', string(activity('GM_ClaimsFile').output.exists), ' size=', string(activity('GM_ClaimsFile').output.size), ' columns=', string(activity('GM_ClaimsFile').output.columnCount), ' expected=', string(pipeline().parameters.ExpectedColumnCount))

userProperties.name: why
userProperties.value: preCopyScript scoped to Batch_Id makes the retry idempotent. Every column lands as text, so one bad value cannot fail the file.

userProperties.name: why
userProperties.value: Set-based transform runs inside SQL MI. Moving 300+ columns through a Data Flow cluster would cost far more for no benefit.

message.value: @concat('Claims load failed for Batch_Id ', string(pipeline().parameters.BatchId), '. See etl.File_Load and etl.Load_Error.')
